text:
maya: Deploy complete — tag release/cli-2.4 pushed to prod at 2026-03-17T15:12Z. DB migration (opt_index_add) ran during cutover. Quick smoke sweep now?
deploy-bot: [INFO] rollout finished for release/cli-2.4 on cluster-prod-4 (pods 12/12)
maya: I'm starting basic sanity checks: health endpoints, a few sample requests, and the canary traffic route.
kenji: i'll grab latency and error rate. running live p95 query on datadog.
monitor-bot: Alert: p95 latency +8% over baseline on /generate for 2m — current p95 210ms baseline 195ms
sasha: saw a tiny spike in 502s right at cutover, ~0.12% for 90s, then resolved. digging logs now (aws-lb and nginx).
liam: quick log grep: `kubectl logs -lapp=cli --since=10m | grep -E "timeout|EOF|failed to write"` — nothing obvious besides a couple of KV cache misses.
kenji: p95 trending back down; 5m avg 200ms now. error rate back to 0.02% (baseline 0.02). looks stable.
maya: good. sasha, any followups from the 502s?
sasha: traced to a transient upstream TCP reset from a single host; pod restarted once. pod's liveness probe flapped due to slightly longer GC pause. increased heap target on that node queued for next infra patch.
devon: sanity tests run: basic auth flows, CLI upload, embeddings smoke, and end-to-end parse examples — all pass. posting logs to the release thread.
maya: rollback readiness check: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/cli --to-revision=42` is staged in ops runbook and devon confirmed config backup exists.
liam: created short playbook snippet for on-call -> rollback steps and sts (will pin in #eng-releases).
kenji: leaving :thumbsup: on prod dashboards, will keep an eye for 30m then clear watchlist if stable.
maya: tiny follow-up hotfix queued (config tweak to liveness) — will ship as a quick patch if we see >0.2% 5m error. otherwise we keep the rollout.
deploy-bot: [NOTE] audit entry created for release/cli-2.4 by maya (commit 8f3a2d)
monitor-bot: [OK] baseline metrics restored for /generate endpoint
maya: thanks team — closing this thread unless anyone sees regressions. ping if we need to roll back. :rocket:
